folder.autoSuggest: Use path based on the name:

lang.intro: You can change this later. Some documents submitted to the department are always in Russian.
lang.inclusionNote: Documents without a mark in the selected language are still included — in their own language (e.g. the NDA undertaking is always in Russian).
lang.tableTitle: Which documents are available in which language

presentation.intro: Choose the presentation format. You can change it later in project settings — but here you see the whole list so you don't miss the options.
presentation.none: This template has no presentation variants.

desc.reveal: HTML slides, flip through in the browser

authors.author: Author {{index}}
authors.hint: If the work is a team effort, add all co-authors. The first author's name becomes the default project name.
authors.needManaged: At least one author must manage their files in this project.
authors.notManagedHint: The author's folder won't be scaffolded — they keep their part of the work elsewhere.
authors.sharedDescription: The team's shared documents (e.g. the common spec) are scaffolded under shared/ and maintained alongside the personal ones.
authors.slugDuplicate: Another author already uses this slug
authors.slugHint: The author's personal documents will live in this project folder.
authors.slugInvalid: The slug must start with a latin letter and contain only a–z, 0–9 and _
authors.teamIntro: Team mode: the project name (the “Folder” step) names the whole system, while each author below has their own topic — their part of the system. An author's personal documents live in the folder named by their slug; shared ones live in shared/.
authors.teamNotSupported: The selected template version does not support team mode. Remove the extra authors or go back and pick a pack version that supports teams.
authors.topicRequired: Enter the topic of this author's part

supervisor.hint: You can leave this empty — add it later in the project settings.
supervisor.hintRequired: A supervisor is required for this template. You can refine the position/degree later in settings.

meta.noRequired: This template has no required meta fields.
meta.ndaDescription: If the work is on a company topic under an NDA, enable this. The agreement documents from the template will be added to the project and the final package.
meta.ndaWarning: The NDA documents from the template will be included in the project and the final package.

review.sharedOn: shared/ — shared documents will be created
